full_name: Laurie Sheck | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Laurie Sheck is the author of four books of poems, including Black Series (Knopf, 2001) and The Willow Grove (Knopf, 1996), a finalist for the Pulitzer Prize. Sheck is a member of the MFA Faculty at New School University in New York City.
